text:
To whom it may concern:

I switched to Eclipse pieces about 3 weeks ago in an effort to decrease my smoking and it has worked.

I find them extremely hard to light, even to keep lit and at times the entire cigarette becomes very hot to the touch, all the way up to the filter, constantly. The frustration to smoke the Eclipse worked for me to stop.

Thanks for inventing them!

Linda Moses

P.S. These are just a few of the ones I had difficulty in lighting.
